therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Transplant eligible patients with multiple myeloma receiving induction therapy with IMiDs
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Venous thromboembolism (VTE)-related death, symptomatic deep-vein thrombosis (DVT), pulmonary embolism (PE), and asymptomatic proximal DVT

results.dose_information: Apixaban 2.5 mg daily for 4 to 6 months depending on number of induction cycles
